I have owned this land for many years and know it well. For this small barley plot, I will use both the compost I prepared last season and some chemical fertilizer from the cooperative to get a good yield, because barley needs nutrients but the plot is too small to waste money on hired labor or chemicals we do not need. I will plant the improved seed the extension worker gave us last year, since it grows better than the local kind. We do not irrigate here—we depend on the rains—and for a plot this size my children and I can manage all the work ourselves.
